'''Silver foils''' were components used aboard [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] bikes. They could also be used to replace the string-guard cables linking the [[Repulsorlift generator/Legends|repulsorlift generator]] to the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] of a [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud car]], resulting in greater power, speed and acceleration. If fitting a larger [[power dispersion unit]] to a small vehicle such as a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]], silver foils were used to create a bridge between the unit and the bike's engine. It helped the engine to adjust to the increase power flow.
